hypotheses.justification: Pulled in only because it is instance-implicit in M. Statement: CohCarrier.GammaH M H (Def_CohCarrier_Level.lean:133, built from Gamma0 M and gamma0Units M) needs no NeZero, nor does ModularForm.mul (needs only Γ.HasDetPlusMinusOne, which comes from the subgroup being an image of SL(2,ℤ)), nor IsIntegralQExp (p.map (Int.castRingHom ℂ) = qExpansion 1 f). Proof: rewrite with ModularForm.coe_mul, then Mathlib's qExpansion_mul, which needs only AnalyticAt of the cuspFunctions at 0. That comes from ModularFormClass.analyticAt_cuspFunction_zero, which needs only 0 < 1 and 1 ∈ strictPeriods. Membership follows from Mathlib's strictPeriods_Gamma1 (any N : ℕ) plus Gamma1_le_GammaH. Gamma1_le_GammaH's proof uses only Gamma1_mem, Gamma0_mem, mem_GammaH_iff and val_gamma0Units, none of which needs NeZero; that section's NeZero comes only from its variable line and is unused. Alternatively, ModularGroup.T ∈ GammaH M H for every M: its lower-left entry is 0 and its gamma0Units value is 1 ∈ H. So the case M = 0 (ZMod 0 = ℤ) works as well, and the same proof goes through with `omit [NeZero M] in`, with the helper lemmas also omitting it or inlined.
